itemUsage.en: Orchestra manager Ripresa, working to build new possibilities for the future of the orchestra.
itemUsage.zh: 乐团经理人复奏，积极地为乐团的未来构筑新的可能性。

itemDesc.en: Her mother left her a great many things: her staff, her conductor's baton, and the entire orchestra. All of these weigh on Ripresa, but it is a weight her hands will surely be able to lift someday.
itemDesc.zh: 养母给她留了很多东西，不论是法杖、指挥棒，还是整个乐团，对于复奏来说都还有些沉重，但总有一天，她的双手能够承担起这份重量。

Operator Ripresa has demonstrated a remarkable aptitude for inflicting Arts casualties on multitudes of enemies.

description.en:
The conductor's baton brushes past the last note on the score, and the performance concludes to fervent applause. As usual, Liesel turns around to bow, but someone in the audience catches her eye. It is a Caprinae woman, around the same age as Paola, with both anxiety and suppressed joy in her eyes, as though she were listening to some distant melody only she could hear.
Why would this bright, uplifting piece bring about such emotions? It was Paola's favorite work, and Liesel had pestered her for months before she figured out the details, for she had been fascinated by the music's freedom and spontaneity, unbound like a dancer upon the vast plains. Paola had told her not to be obsessed with accuracy, but to imagine the floating sensation of being thrown to the clouds...
'Thank you. I thought I would never hear music like that again.
'I used to hear such melodies from street corners in my hometown. It was the most unrestrained sound I'd ever heard. But then the wandering musician was chased off by the guards.
'The musicians of the spires say that such dissonance is an affront to art, that it is only beautiful to the untrained.
'But... is beauty something that can be so arbitrarily defined?'
The woman falls silent. There seemed to be some kind of unspeakable pain there, hidden where Liesel could not tread. Perhaps it was the very reason Paola came to Nuovo Volsinii. She recalls Paola's comments in the margins of a copied score:
Expression and beauty are not privileges, and nothing can stop true passion. Do not be fazed by criticism and scrutiny. Express yourself to your heart's delight, and we shall meet in equality. Passion will create unity, and we will come together to make new things.
Liesel had not understood at the time. All she knew was that the words were beautiful and warm, just like Paola herself. Now, seeing the longing and sorrow in this woman's eyes, she realizes that the reason this piece was Paola's favorite was not because of the beauty of the music itself, but because it represented the voices of the musicians who loved music, and Paola's own vision when she founded the orchestra. Everyone who expresses themselves through their instrument deserves to be listened to.
This brings her one step closer to Paola.
'My mother left Leithanien, brought this music here, and taught it to me. Now that it's where people can hear it, this orchestra will make sure it deserves to be heard.'
Liesel extends her hand.
'Welcome to Nuova Volsinii. We'll perform it again next time.'
The woman smiles, a faint smile as if her doubts have faded away.
'Thank you... I'll come again.'
As Liesel watches the woman leave, she recalls how Paola stood upon the podium, and the dedication on the score—
To all musicians.
Liesel Memminger takes a deep breath and looks up.
She must prepare for tomorrow's performance.
description.zh:
指挥棒划过面前铜板上乐谱的最后一个音符，演出结束在延绵不断的掌声中。莉泽尔像往常一样，转身向观众致意，她的目光掠过台下，却感受到了一丝莫名的异样。那是一位与葆拉年纪相仿的卡普里尼女士，眼神中藏匿着些许不安，又带着某种压抑住的欣喜——像是在聆听某种已经远去的、只有自己才能听见的旋律。
这首欢快明亮的曲子为何会带来这样的情绪？这是葆拉妈妈心仪的曲子，她缠着葆拉妈妈花了好几个月才弄清那些调式里的细节，因为她沉醉于其中的奔放和随性，像无边无际原野上的舞者一般无拘无束。葆拉妈妈还告诉她，不必执着于准确性，想象自己被抛入云层中的空灵感觉……
“谢谢你，我以为……我以为我再也听不到这样的曲子了。
“我在家乡的街角听过相似的旋律，那是我听过的最自由的声音，但是，警卫后来赶跑了那个流浪的老乐师……
“那些高塔乐师说，这样的音乐乖张走板，是对至高艺术的亵渎。只有没受过正统训练的乐师才会视其为……美。
“但是，美是某种可以被谁定义的东西吗……？”
女士沉默许久，那个莉泽尔未曾踏足的地方，似乎潜藏着某些不能言说的痛楚，那或许是葆拉妈妈当年来到新沃尔西尼的原因之一。她想起葆拉妈妈曾经在誊抄的乐谱旁写下她的感悟：
表达和审美从来不是任何人的特权，热爱也无法被阻挡。不必害怕责难和审视，只要愿意尽情挥洒，人们便能在平等中相逢，那些热爱会促成团结，人们会因此走到一起，凝聚出新的事物。
那时莉泽尔还不太懂，她只觉得这些话很美好，很温暖，就像葆拉妈妈本人一样。如今，面对这位女士眼中的渴望和哀伤，她突然明白，这首葆拉妈妈最喜欢的曲子，也承载着她建立乐团的信念，并不是因为它足够优美，而是因为这是热爱着音乐的乐师们内心的声音，拿起乐器，便值得被倾听。
她距离葆拉妈妈又近了一步。
“我的母亲从莱塔尼亚离开，带着这首曲子来到这里，将它教给了我。既然它走到了能够被人们听见的地方，乐团也会让它值得被倾听。”
莉泽尔伸出手。
“欢迎来到新沃尔西尼，下次演出，我们还会演奏它。”
面前的女士笑了，那是个很轻的笑容，像是有什么困惑烟消云散了。
“谢谢……我会来的。”
莉泽尔目送女士离去，她想起葆拉妈妈站在指挥台上的样子，想起乐谱上的那行小字——
献给所有乐师。
莉泽尔·梅明格深吸一口气，抬起头。
明天，还有明天的演出要准备。
